text:
Sam Lee: Quick review: the 'Create new API token' confirmation toast says 'Token created. Copy now or it will be truncated.' Users reported confusion about 'truncated' and what happens if they dismiss the toast. Screenshot: https://redwood/mockups/token-toast.png

Zoë Martinez: Ugh yeah 'truncated' is scary and vague. We should say exactly what the limitation is (we only show it once) and how to retrieve it later (can't view the full token after creation).

Caleb Rivers: Current toast copy: \"Token created. Copy now — this token will be truncated in the UI.\" We want something shorter and less scary for non-technical PMs.

Ivy Park: Proposal A (concise, friendly):
```
"Token created. Copy it now 1 you won't be able to view it again." 
[Copy] [Got it]
```
Notes: avoid 'truncated'. Use plain language: 'won't be able to view it again.' Make primary focus on Copy.

Sam Lee: Accessibility note: if the toast contains an actionable Copy button, keyboard focus should move to it when toast appears, and screen readers should announce the availability of the button and that the token is shown once. Maybe add visually hidden text: 'Token displayed once for security.'

Zoë Martinez: I like A but change 'you won't be able to view it again' to 'we won't show it again' to sound less accusatory:
```
"Token created. Copy it now 1 we won't show it again." 
```

Caleb Rivers: Or even shorter: \"Token created. This is the only time we'll show it.\" Cleaner.

Ivy Park: For screen readers, include `aria-live=polite` on the toast and an `aria-describedby` that includes the token visibility note. Also ensure the copy button has `aria-label=\"Copy token (displayed once)\"`.

A11yBot: Created task: a11y/toasts - token creation toast (aria-live, focus management, button labels). Reference: /docs/a11y/toasts.

Sam Lee: Microcopy variants to test in PR:
- "Token created. Copy it now 1 we won't show it again."
- "Token created. This is the only time we'll show it."
- "Token created. Save it now 1 we can't display it later."

Zoë Martinez: For tone, prefer the middle one. It's direct but not bossy. Also, replace 'Save' with 'Copy' for clarity since most will paste rather than save a file.

Caleb Rivers: UX nit: if user dismisses toast, add a small inline banner at top of API tokens page for 10s that says "Token created — copy from the page now" with a tertiary Copy button. That gives an extra chance without exposing token later. Thoughts?

Ivy Park: That defeats the security model if we keep showing token anywhere. If we implement a short-lived banner, limit scope to the session and ensure the token value is cleared from memory after copy. Also document this in the security notes.

Sam Lee: Maybe simpler: keep toast only but offer a persistent resource: "Create new token" flow should prompt to download a .txt immediately if user wants. We can link to that in the toast: 'Copy now or download .txt'. But link/button count in toast could get crowded.

Zoë Martinez: Keep it simple for now: change copy to the middle variant, make Copy the primary focus, implement aria attributes, and add a docs link in the token creation modal explaining retrieval policy and download option.

Caleb Rivers: Agreed. I'll update the Figma and PR: copy variant "Token created. This is the only time we'll show it." + Copy primary focus + aria-label on Copy button + aria-live on toast + short docs link in modal.

Ivy Park: I'll review the PR for the accessibility bits. Make sure Enter triggers Copy but Esc dismisses toast without copying.

Sam Lee: Thanks all :thumbsup:
